sources.name: Humanity's Last Exam (CAIS official)
sources.notes: Raw JSON API that feeds the live results widget on lastexam.ai and the CAIS AI Dashboard (dashboard.safe.ai). Returns 403 unless sent with Origin/Referer lastexam.ai. One entry per model (usually the "high" effort run). Numbers differ from Scale SEAL HLE (e.g. Fable 5.1 54.6 vs 46.5, Astra 53.6 vs 54.8) - likely different eval set/judge (HLE-Rolling vs original); treat as a separate source, not a duplicate. No update date in the payload; newest entry released 2026-09-04. The static table on lastexam.ai itself is stale (Apr 2025 dataset, Gemini 3 Pro top). Medium confidence because the dataset version behind the "hle" field is undocumented.
